title: 2022 Panini Score Football Kenny Pickett RC Rookie Card Pittsburgh Steelers #301
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2022 Panini Score Football card features Kenny Pickett, a rookie player from the Pittsburgh Steelers. The card is made of high-quality card stock material and belongs to the base set of the Score collection. It has a card number of 301 and is an original, licensed reprint.

The card is perfect for any National Football League (NFL) fan and collector, especially those who are looking for a valuable addition to their collection. It is a standard-sized card and has no autograph or vintage features. The card is manufactured in the United States by Panini and is a must-have for any football enthusiast.
